formula: CS = alpha/(alpha+beta); alpha' = alpha + w*s, beta' = beta + w*f; order-independent (commutative addition); |dCS| decreases as alpha+beta grows; decay scales both
notes: Not built: qbselfknow notes 'Confidence is still a single trust score'. Core to 157-159, 174, 188, 189, 196.
rule: CS = alpha/(alpha+beta); posterior by conjugate addition alpha' = alpha + w*s, beta' = beta + w*f; order-independent.
function: Hold ConfidenceScore as Beta parameters alpha (supporting evidence) and beta (contradicting evidence) rather than a scalar; report CS as alpha/(alpha+beta); update in closed form by adding the observing source's reliability weight to whichever parameter the evidence supports, so revision magnitude falls as accumulated evidence grows without any rule conditioned on it; decay shrinks both parameters toward the prior, widening the credible interval while preserving the mean.

formula: n0 = alpha+beta = g(CSW); alpha = CS*n0, beta = (1-CS)*n0; single contradiction weight w: CS' = alpha/(n0 + w); |CS - CS'| = CS*w/(n0+w) < additive increment when n0 large
notes: Not built.
rule: Revision from a single contradiction against a strong prior must fall below the increment the additive rule would have applied.
function: Initialise Beta parameters for a concept node from ConceptStabilityWeight, which sets the pseudo-count n0 = alpha+beta while the current confidence sets the ratio; a high-CSW node therefore requires multi-source contradicting evidence to revise, which is the behaviour §41.4.5 asserts and the additive rule does not produce.

formula: var = CS*(1-CS)/(alpha+beta+1); gain = var_prior/(var_prior + var_error) = pi_error/(pi_error + pi_prior); 0 <= gain <= 1
notes: Not built.
rule: gain = var_prior / (var_prior + var_error), equivalently pi_error / (pi_error + pi_prior); var = CS(1-CS)/(alpha+beta+1).
function: Compute an error signal's precision as inverse variance from the Beta parameters already held under §41.6.2; propagate a contradiction upward to World Brain concept attributes by a gain equal to the error's share of total precision, so a poorly-supported observation barely revises a settled concept while a well-established one substantially revises a weakly-held concept; replaces the ConfidenceScore-differential magnitude of §41.5.1.

formula: withhold revision iff gain < floor; withheld contradiction still recorded

formula: admissible iff |residual| <= tol * |Q_conserved|; constraints evaluated before plausibility scoring

Under §41.6.2 those two quantities are the Beta posterior mean and the accumulated evidence count, so the weight is the product of the two parameters the confidence representation already holds. A weighting refinement over the World Model Domain's existing hypergraph traversal, not a new traversal mechanism.

formula: admit completion iff attention-weighted support >= floor
notes: Not built.

Distinct from WorldModel.Infer, which completes a general scene by Schema, Physics, Affordance and Relation rules: this is geometric, hyperedge-granular and convergence-based. It introduces no dynamical system of its own; it is Claim 6's mechanism applied at hyperedge granularity.

The denials carry the accuracy guarantees: D12 to D4 denied so analysis never grounds an answer, D13 to D4 and D7 denied so commerce never influences retrieval or generation, D9 to D2 denied so no surface bypasses the slice, D11 to D0 denied so governance cannot amend the Prime Directive.

formula: undiscriminated(H1,H2) iff |P(H1) - P(H2)| < sep_floor and n(H1) > n_min and n(H2) > n_min
notes: Not built.

function: Detect continuously where two hypotheses concerning a common subject have posteriors within the configured separation floor while each exceeds a minimum support count; mark the pair undiscriminated and invoke §97.8.2. A pair in which one hypothesis is weakly supported is under-evidenced rather than undiscriminated and is routed to the existing evidence-seeking mechanism instead.

formula: disc(E) = |P(E|H1) - P(E|H2)|; select E* = argmax disc(E); generate only if disc(E*) >= disc_floor
notes: Not built.

function: For each obtainable candidate observation compute the magnitude of the difference between its likelihood under each hypothesis, and select the maximum; select irrespective of how probable either hypothesis considers the observation, so an observation both predict equally is never selected; withhold generation where no candidate clears the discrimination floor; emit a structured request stating both hypotheses' posteriors under presence and under absence, so the outcome is interpretable before the observation is obtained.

Deduction may write to the knowledge store; induction and abduction may not.

formula: propose generalization iff subordinate_count >= min_count and alpha > beta
notes: Not built.

function: Operate the evidence-integration layer: accumulate corroborating and contradicting evidence as posterior parameters, weight corroboration by source independence, elevate confidence for cross-modal agreement within a temporal window, hold a concept provisional until the consolidation count is met, and retain every contradiction too weak to revise the model so a pattern of individually-insignificant negatives stays queryable. A generalization is emitted only where subordinate support and evidential strength both clear their floors.

formula: D = 1 / sum_i (w_i / sum_j w_j)^2 over source classes; 1 <= D <= k (k classes); D = 1 iff all weight in one class
notes: Not built (qbselfknow: Observation Diversity specified).
rule: D = 1 / sum_i (w_i / sum_j w_j)^2 over registered source classes; D=1 where all weight is in one class.
function: Attribute every increment of the confidence parameters to a registered source class and compute the effective number of contributing classes as the reciprocal of the summed squared weight proportions; admit a corroboration from an already-dominant class at reduced weight; require a diversity floor as well as a count floor before proposing a generalization; attenuate precision-weighted revision where a contradiction's diversity approaches unity; and disclose concentration in an output relying on a record below the diversity threshold.

A stated preference overrides an inferred signal at any stage, and where two layers modulate one dimension incompatibly the later stage governs form and the earlier substance.

formula: contradicting report: beta' = beta + w_source; CS = alpha/(alpha+beta)
notes: Not built. No answer feedback UI found. Depends on 156.

function: Record every delivered response with its query, scope description, cited records and their confidence at delivery; admit a reader's report on that response as a knowledge record through the ordinary extraction path with the reporting identity as attributed source. A report against a cited record increments that record's contradicting parameter by the source's weight — it does not set confidence, supersede the record or remove it. The reporting identity counts as a source class, so ten reports from one identity weigh less than ten from ten. A report is never admissible as grounding for the subject matter it concerns.

notes: Not built. Duplicate subject gate of 152.

formula: score = (1/n) * sum_i (c_i - o_i)^2 per domain and per confidence band; 0 <= score <= 1
notes: Not built. Same Brier form as 151.

function: Compute over paired responses and outcomes the mean of squared differences between the confidence stated at delivery and the realised outcome, per domain and per confidence band, so a system well calibrated in one domain and poorly in another is not concealed by an aggregate; a finding of poor calibration is as reportable as one of good calibration and identifies where a confidence value should not be offered at its current precision.

formula: gap_band = mean(o_i in band) - mean(c_i in band); finding iff |gap_band| >= tolerance; sent as proposal to named human
notes: Not built.

function: Compute per confidence band the difference between the proportion of realised outcomes and the mean confidence stated in that band; raise a calibration finding where the magnitude reaches the configured tolerance; emit the finding as an improvement proposal to a named human reviewer rather than applying it, with the parameters governing the measurement itself held in the permanently-excluded set so the mechanism cannot adjust the terms on which it is judged.

A register governs voicing only: it alters no admitted record, no confidence value and no permissible vocabulary, so the authoritative register never removes a hedge a confidence value requires and the supportive register never softens an assertion the records state plainly.

function: Select the supportive register only on a stated preference, a configured default for an accessibility or discipline configuration, or the existing consent-gated prosodic signal; never by inference from word choice, punctuation, query length, error rate, retry behaviour or interaction timing, and construct no record of an inferred affective state. Where in effect it acknowledges the requester's stated position, reduces density and avoids imperative construction, while withholding no answer the records support and altering no confidence value.

A transformed asset carries its transformation provenance; an interpretive modulation selects among includable assets and cannot render one includable; an accessible equivalent accompanies each included asset at the same production stage.

rule: An expectation is evaluated only at a registered level of the hierarchy.

formula: share_L = residual_L / sum_L residual_L; attribute error to the lowest L with share_L >= s_config; revise only L
notes: Not built.
rule: Level share = level residual / total residual; attribution goes to the lowest level clearing the configured share.
function: Attribute a prediction error to the lowest level whose residual accounts for the configured share of total residual, applying revision at that level alone and passing nothing upward; a mis-parsed sentence says nothing about physics. Without this rule a mis-read unit propagates until it perturbs a physical constraint, and a system revising invariants on parsing errors becomes less reliable the more it reads.

formula: attribute(L) iff for all L' < L: share_L' < s_config; revision magnitude by precision weighting
notes: Not built.
rule: A level is attributed only where each lower level's residual falls below the configured share.
function: Escalate to a level only where every level below it fails the share test, so a conceptual revision requires lexical and sequential residuals below the share and an invariant revision requires all three below it; an invariant is revised only where the observation survived every cheaper explanation. Revision magnitude at the attributed level remains governed by precision weighting, so attribution fixes where and precision fixes how far.

formula: for all L: share_L < s_config => record in contradiction index, no revision; registered physical constraints never revised by observation
notes: Not built.
rule: An unattributed error is recorded and applied nowhere; physical constraints are never revised by observation.
function: Where no level clears the share, record the observation in the contradiction index and apply no revision anywhere — an error no level accounts for is a finding about the hierarchy, not an instruction to it; surface repeated unattributed errors against a common expectation as a pattern, since one is noise and a hundred is a missing level. No level revises a registered physical constraint; an apparently contradicting observation enters the index rather than relaxing it.

formula: budget_used = sum_class hops_class * cost_class; halt traversal when budget_used would exceed B; cost_semantic < cost_editorial < cost_temporal
notes: Not built. apps/_core/qbdsn.py routes lookups across dataset stores by learned pathways (THETA=0.30, ETA=0.10) — a different mechanism.
rule: Budget consumed = sum over classes of (hops x cost); traversal halts when the registered budget is exhausted.
function: Assign each edge class a traversal cost and bound pre-activation by a budget in cost units rather than by hop count: semantic edges cheap because meaning stays informative over distance, editorial dearer because relevance decays across version boundaries, temporal dearest because adjacency in time is weak evidence of relatedness and a long walk gathers noise. Costs are registered configuration recorded with the response, never adjusted by the system from its own experience.

formula: reach_class = floor(B / cost_class); same query + same cost table => same pre-activated set
notes: Not built.
rule: Reach of a class = budget / cost per hop for that class.
function: Derive each edge class's reach from its cost against the traversal budget, so a query may reach widely through meaning and shallowly through time at the same cost as the reverse; traversal is bounded by construction rather than by a stopping heuristic, and the same query under the same cost table pre-activates the same set on every execution.

formula: admissible_as_grounding(result) iff posture in {attested_past, live_present}; projected_future carries a credible interval and is labelled, never stored as a record
ui_note: Every answer shows a badge saying whether it is attested past, live present or projected future (with its credible interval).
notes: qbselfknow marks §36 partial only because Fact Units carry an ingestion timestamp (ufcs_store.py 'temporal.ingested'); no posture resolution exists.
rule: A result is admissible as grounding only where its posture is attested-past or live-present; projected-future is labelled and withheld.
function: User-facing§123.2 Resolve a query in exactly one of three postures and state which produced the answer: attested past under the attestation-horizon cutoff, live present reading the live layer over the committed layer, or projected future carrying a credible interval. Past and present results are ordinary knowledge records; a projected result is never admitted as a record and never grounds a subsequent generation. Where a response draws on more than one posture each proposition carries its own, so a difference between answers reads as a difference of posture rather than an inconsistency.

formula: coherence = min(c_semantic, c_temporal, c_spatial, c_editorial, c_media, c_evidential); governing dimension = argmin
notes: §37 'specified' in qbselfknow; not built.
rule: coherence = MIN over the six dimensional values; the governing dimension is named with the result.
function: Compute a coherence value across semantic, temporal, spatial, editorial, media and evidential dimensions, each derived from mechanisms already specified, and take the least of the six as governing rather than the mean, since a mean lets five strong dimensions conceal the one weak dimension that is the actual finding.

formula: stable if c >= f_upper; drifting if f_lower <= c < f_upper; misaligned if c < f_lower; incomplete if a dimension is uncomputable; contradictory if a specific incompatible pair is recorded
notes: Not built.
rule: Stable at or above the upper floor; drifting between floors; misaligned below the lower floor.
function: Classify by the governing value against configured floors — stable, drifting, misaligned — always naming the dimension that produced the classification; distinguish two further states with different causes and remedies: incomplete, where a dimension cannot be computed for want of data, and contradictory, where two records assert incompatible content and a specific pair is recorded. Coherence informs and never gates: it adjusts no confidence, admits or excludes no record, and withholds no output.

formula: key = H(device_class, entitlement_set, locale, register, audience_level, temporal_posture, cost_table, convergence_regime); key_a = key_b => output_a = output_b (else defect); key_a != key_b => no determinism claim
notes: Not built (§37 Context Lock 'specified').
rule: Determinism is asserted between two executions only where the context key computed over the locked dimensions is identical.
function: Enumerate the context dimensions whose values must agree for the determinism guarantee to hold — device class, entitlement set, locale, expressive register, audience level, temporal posture, traversal cost table, convergence regime — compute a key over them and return it with the output. Identical keys mean the outputs must be identical and a difference is a defect; differing keys mean nothing is claimed. The enumeration is in the permanently-excluded set, since a mechanism able to unlock a dimension could restore apparent determinism by narrowing what determinism means.

formula: gradient(a,b) = |relevance(a) - relevance(b)| for neighbours within one edge class; traverse in ascending gradient order; not stored
notes: Not built.
rule: gradient = |relevance(a) - relevance(b)| across neighbours in an edge class; lower gradient is traversed first.
function: Compute at traversal time the rate of change of relevance across a record's neighbours within an edge class, and order traversal to prefer directions of lower gradient, since slowly-changing relevance marks a region of stable meaning while a sharp change marks a boundary beyond which traversal gathers material of a different kind. Computed from values the records already carry, stored nowhere, adding no schema field, and altering the order in which the §123.1 budget is spent rather than what is reachable within it.

function: Admin§4.10.1Operator Register a computational substrate — neuromorphic processor, memristive array, multi-electrode array — as a source under a declared capability and its output as a modality with its own independently-failing extractor, so a substrate that becomes unavailable removes one modality and leaves the rest operating; reduce its output to concept-level records before admission, retain no raw episode, pass the safety gate, calibrate confidence against the substrate's registered reliability, and treat the substrate as a source class so many readings from one array do not weigh as readings from many.

formula: conf_derived = min(reliability_substrate, reliability_interpretation); no registered interpretation => measurement of the substrate only
notes: Not built.

function: Admit a substrate output as a measurement of that substrate's behaviour; admit it as bearing on any other subject only through an interpretation registered in advance with its own provenance and reliability, revisable by an operator. Absent a registered interpretation the output is a measurement of the substrate and nothing more, since a response to a stimulus is evidence of what the substrate produced and not of what it was asked about.

ui_note: Operator dispatches stimuli to a registered substrate and sees each stimulus logged with who sent it.
notes: Not built. Rule text (confidence floor) does not match the Function (stimulus dispatch).

Where a substrate comprises living tissue, the operating institution's governance and any review its jurisdiction requires apply; this specification authorises no substrate's operation.

formula: digital MACs per update = N^2; analog: I_j = sum_i G_ij * V_i (Ohm + Kirchhoff) in one settling; s_j = sign(I_j - I_ref)
notes: Hardware embodiment; aspirational. Neuromorphic/attractor layer is not built; apps/_core/qbselfknow.py COVERAGE marks §3/§35 'specified' and answers 'are you neuromorphic?' with 'not yet built'.
rule: Digital multiply-accumulates per update = N^2; one analog settling performs the same summation as a single physical operation.
function: Perform the threshold update by the settling of a variable-conductance array rather than by computing it: activations applied as row potentials, weights as element conductances, the weighted sum as column current, the stable state read by comparing current against a reference. The mapping is exact rather than analogical — Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws produce the summation — and the duration of one settling does not scale with network size, where a digital update of an 8,192-unit network performs 67,108,864 multiply-accumulates.

formula: analog_permitted iff registered_regime = unique_equilibrium (||W||_2 < 1)
notes: Not built.
rule: Analog operation is permitted only where the network's registered convergence regime is unique-equilibrium.
function: Permit analog realization only under the §116.2 monotone parameterization, refusing an array operated under the capacity bound alone. Conductance elements cannot be manufactured exactly, so two arrays hold weight matrices differing by fabrication tolerance; under a capacity bound both converge but may settle to different stable states while each behaves correctly, whereas under a unique equilibrium both settle to the same one. Uniqueness ceases to be a strengthening and becomes the precondition.

formula: agree(A,B) iff |state_A - state_B| <= read_tolerance; |I_col - I_ref| <= tol => resettle, unresolved => digital fallback; disagreement beyond tolerance => fault
notes: Not built.
rule: Two arrays agree where |state_A - state_B| <= registered read tolerance; beyond it a fault is raised.
function: Register each array with its dimensions, conductance range, fabrication tolerance and read tolerance; resolve a column falling within tolerance of the threshold by a further settling rather than by rounding, and report unresolved with fallback to the digital path where it does not resolve; require two arrays on a common input under a common weight specification to agree within tolerance, raising a fault on divergence rather than averaging, since averaging two disagreeing results produces a state neither array reached and a state no array reached is not an attractor of either.

formula: parameterize ||W||_2 < 1 (not diagonal dominance); reported simulation: 64 units, 6 patterns, 5% conductance variation => disagreement(contraction) < disagreement(capacity bound)
notes: Empirical claim; no simulation code found in the suite (sim/dsn_stress.py tests the DSN router, not attractor arrays).
rule: Disagreement rate between two varied weight matrices is materially lower under a spectral contraction than under the capacity bound.
function: Parameterize by spectral norm below unity rather than by diagonal dominance: a diagonal-dominance constraint collapses the state toward zero where a unit's sign is near-ambiguous, yielding a unique equilibrium carrying no information, whereas a contraction retains the structure the weights encode. Simulated over 64 units holding six patterns, two matrices differing by 5% conductance variation settled differently on 30.5% of inputs under the capacity bound and 0.5% under a contraction at spectral norm 0.9 — recorded as a simulation result, not a hardware measurement.

formula: conf_converted = min(reliability_engine, reliability_extraction_instruction)
notes: v9.64 has a single fixed extraction prompt, not per-engine registered profiles with semantic markers and schema constraints; extracted facts get a flat trust (0.5). Apps forbid AI-model hosts entirely (apps/_core/qbagents.py LLM_HOSTS; apps/facts/sources.py AI_HOSTS) — design conflict with §40 AI-Engine Ingestion.
rule: Confidence of a converted record = MIN(engine reliability, extraction-instruction reliability).
function: Compose a prompt from knowledge records through the regeneration mechanism under the vocabulary constraint, adding semantic markers naming the concepts to address, extraction instructions specifying the return form, and alignment constraints stating the target record schema; compose per engine from a registered profile recording accepted input form, context bound, declared capabilities and reliability. Composition is deterministic, so an identical request under an identical profile yields an identical prompt and a differing reply is attributable to the engine rather than to the asking.

Prevents the failure in which the authority behind a cited claim turns out to be that a model produced it when asked.

Prevents confidence manufactured by repetition, where a hundred elicitations from one model would otherwise report near-certainty for a claim no source ever made.

Record contradictions with authored records in the contradiction index, noting the derivation difference so a reviewer knows one side originated from a model.

formula: a_i <- a_i - k * sum_{j inconsistent with i} a_j, iterated to stable state under threshold update; retain i iff a_i > retention_floor
notes: Not built. v9.64 qb_chat.gate() only flags CONTRADICTED (functional predicate with >1 object) without resolving.

The competition is among candidates rather than among domains, since a domain owns exactly one decision and two domains proposing competing answers would contradict the partition. Where two candidates survive at comparable activation the set does not resolve and clarification is requested rather than the higher being taken.

Refuse an arithmetic combination of two values of differing dimension rather than computing it.

formula: non-forecast: confidence = publisher authority (no extraction/modality/source calibration applied); forecast: point = registered_rule(published_interval), interval retained
notes: Not built.

function: Admit a non-forecast value at its publisher's authority without applying extraction confidence, modality coefficient or source reliability, since calibration would invent an uncertainty that does not exist — a published price is not 87% likely to be the price. The record asserts that the authority published the value, not that it is correct. A forecast is admitted carrying the uncertainty its publisher states. Where a publisher states an interval, retain the interval and compute any required point by a registered rule rather than selecting one.

formula: serve iff (t_query - t_publication) <= staleness_bound; else return age and t_publication (no extrapolation or substitution; values expire, never decay)
notes: Not built.
rule: Serve where (query time − publication time) ≤ staleness bound; otherwise return the age and the publication time.
function: Serve a value only where its age at query time is within the registered staleness bound; beyond it state the age and publication time rather than serving, extrapolating or substituting the nearest available. A feed value does not decay — it expires, since a quoted value does not grow less certain with age but becomes superseded, and answering from it is not answering with lower confidence but answering wrongly. Absence of publication within a multiple of the refresh interval marks the feed interrupted, distinguishing a stopped feed from an unchanged value.

notes: Not built. Restatement vs correction by registered policy; prior value stays queryable and unmarked for restatements.
rule: A revision is a restatement or a correction by registered policy; the relation determines whether the prior value is marked erroneous.
function: Record a publisher's revision of an already-reported period as a restatement related to the prior value, retaining the prior value unmarked and queryable as what was published at its publication time — because it was not wrong, it was correct on the information then available. Reserve the supersession chain and the erroneous marking for a revision issued as a correction. A revision arriving outside the registered restatement policy is held for a named human rather than classified by inference.

formula: include(value, response) iff use in redistribution_entitlement(requester) where use in {display, derive, delayed, redistribute}; enforced at composition; derived values inherit the most restrictive input entitlement

Enforce at composition rather than at export: a response that would carry a value beyond its entitlement is composed without it and the entitlement is stated, so the requester is told rather than left to infer. A derived value carries the source feed's entitlement unless a registered derivation discharges it, so an entitlement cannot be escaped by computing on a value and redistributing the result.

An agent without a termination condition is not registrable.
